## Workload

Lena Fischer completed 232 reads over 396 hours of grading activity. This represents an average of 0.6 reads per hour. The workload was recorded for review to support consideration of the time required for grading and the overall volume completed.

## Quality

A sample of 23 reads was checked as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement rate was 65.2 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistency in grading decisions and identify areas for further attention.

The work was reviewed by Priya Anand.
